annotations.title: Move a prospect through the outreach pipeline

description: Link Building Tool: move a prospect through the outreach-status pipeline — prospected -> contacted -> replied -> link_placed/declined/no_response ('declined'/'no_response' can loop back to 'contacted' for a re-approach). FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. Throws on an illegal jump (e.g. prospected straight to link_placed) — the error names the allowed next stage(s). Always appends an activity-log entry describing the change.

note.description: Optional extra context appended to the auto-generated activity-log entry, e.g. 'sent follow-up #2'.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: update_link_prospect_status
